title: Typed seeds and Python Random streams at LP2 page openings
question: Can the pinned typed-seed Python Random streams produce one of nine fixed known-reading openings at an LP2 page start under the source's F-rune interruption choices?
reader_question: Were words, dates and numbers tried as Python random seeds?
summary: The pinned source's 15,408 typed-seed PRNG configurations were checked across four F-rune masks, 55 nonempty LP2-00–55 page starts and nine fixed 12-rune openings. None matched all 12 runes.
finding: Zero of 61,632 source configuration-and-mask paths produces a complete fixed opening; the longest prefix is five runes. This is a new opening-crib check, separate from the source's LP2-00 English-score result.
limitations: This assumes one of nine known-reading openings appears at one of the included page starts. It uses CPython 3.12 seed behavior, source-specified stream modes and first-two-F masks at zero key offset; it does not rule out other seeds, plaintexts or interruption rules.
next_steps: Only extend this grid with a source-motivated new seed, offset or plaintext crib and keep its scope explicit.

scope.representation: Current GP29 transcription, first 12 decoded runes from each nonempty LP2-00–55 page, compared to nine fixed 12-rune published reading openings.
scope.procedure: Execute the pinned source's seed literals, date loop and six Python Random stream modes; apply two decode signs and each of four source-defined first-two-F removal masks; compare fixed openings with strict no-skip key alignment.
scope.parameters: 1,284 typed seed entries × six modes × two signs = 15,408 source configs; four F masks each = 61,632 paths. Key length 260, zero offset; 55 page starts and nine 12-rune cribs.
scope.exclusions: No Python 2 string seed implementation, source English scorer, reverse key stream, key-skip filter, nonzero offsets, other pages, other cribs or arbitrary new seeds.

review.reviewer: Independent stream-mode samples and four-mask planted plaintext controls

reproduction.environment: CPython 3.12 standard library; pinned MIT-licensed source program. No network or English-scoring model required.

visuals.caption: Count of source seed-and-mask paths that can match at least each number of fixed opening runes. Bars use a log scale; labels show exact counts.
